scope: Proposition 5.8 (The cell flux and weak equation) of the manuscript “Uniform real Lipschitz surfaces on the triangular lattice” (preprints/Uniform-real-Lipschitz-surfaces-on-the-triangular-lattice-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 232 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dce5ae39087f446a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 37. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the preceding inputs, j(q) is well defined on the vector space of attained slopes and is linear there. If any nonzero slope is attained, every slope in R2 is attained and j(q) = Aq for a finite scalar A. For a stationary comparison with drift difference n−2b(x/n), every subsequential expected macroscopic difference m satisfies ∫ j(∇m) · ∇f = ∫ bf, f ∈ C∞ c (U), (5.6) in each limiting open region U free of observations.
